def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # aim at the enemy's right side (their right wheel was at 48%)
    h = radians(enemy.heading)
    # enemy's right side of its heading is 90 deg clockwise from its heading
    tx = enemy.x - 0.45 * sin(h)

    b = bearing_to(tx, ty)
    d = distance_to(tx, ty)
    t = max(-1, min(1, b / 40.0))
    if d < 0.7:
        t = max(-0.35, min(0.35, b / 60.0))
    left = 1.0 - max(0.0, t)
    right = 1.0 + min(0.0, t)
    if b < 0:
        left = 1.0 + t
        right = 1.0 - min(0.0, t)
    if d > 1.5 and abs(b) > 100:
